responsibility: Declares GCC-specific urlifier helpers for diagnostics. It exposes factories for the standard GCC documentation urlifier, helpers for building full documentation URLs, RAII wrappers for temporarily overriding the active urlifier on global_dc, and the attribute_urlifier classes used to auto-link quoted attribute names to their documentation during diagnostic emission.
same_name_distinction: This header is the declaration side of the gcc-urlifier group: unlike gcc/gcc-urlifier.cc, which implements GCC documentation-link lookup and override mechanics, and gcc/gcc-urlifier.def, which supplies the quoted-text mapping data, it exposes the public helpers, RAII wrappers, and attribute-urlifier class declarations.
